steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.bears.directorT=9999; g.env.setTime(9.5); g.env.weather.cloud=0.25; g.env.weather.cloudTarget=0.25; g.env.weather.timer=9999; g.hud.hint && g.hud.hint('',0); return 'clear morning'})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game, f=g.fishing; const until=async(fn,ms)=>{ const t0=performance.now(); while(performance.now()-t0<ms){ if(fn()) return true; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50)); } return false; }; __rhf.press('primary'); if(!await until(()=>f.state==='meter',60000)) return 'no meter: '+f.state; const um=f.updateMeter.bind(f); window.__unfreeze=()=>{ f.updateMeter=um; }; f.updateMeter=(dt,tap)=>um(0,tap); const hb=f.aim.hotBand, wb=f.aim.waterBands.slice().sort((a,b)=>(b.p1-b.p0)-(a.p1-a.p0))[0]; const pw=hb?(hb.p0+hb.p1)/2:(wb.p0+wb.p1)/2; f.meter.t=1.15*Math.pow(pw,1/1.3); await until(()=>Math.abs(f.meter.needle-pw)<1e-6,60000); __rhf.press('primary'); await until(()=>f.meter.phase===1,60000); f.meter.t=0.46/f.timing.speed; await until(()=>Math.abs(f.meter.cursor-0.46)<1e-6,60000); return 'timing bar held with the marker at '+f.meter.cursor.toFixed(2)+', power '+pw.toFixed(2)+(hb?' on the hotspot':' in open water'); })()

(async()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; const t0=performance.now(); while(f.state!=='waiting' && performance.now()-t0<180000) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); return 'float '+f.state+' after '+((performance.now()-t0)/1000).toFixed(1)+' s'})()

(async()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; for(let i=0;i<900;i++){ if(f.encounter && f.encounter.phase==='bite'){ __rhf.press('primary'); return 'hooked at '+i; } if(f.encounter && f.encounter.phase==='approach'){ f.encounter.t=f.encounter.dur; } if(f.encounter && f.encounter.phase==='nibble'){ f.encounter.nibbles=0; f.encounter.gap=0; } await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); } return 'no bite '+f.state})()

(async()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; const t0=performance.now(); while(!f.fight && performance.now()-t0<60000) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2500)); return 'fight '+(!!f.fight)})()

(()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; const F=f.fight; if(!F) return 'no fight '+f.state; F.state='jump'; F.jumpT=0.25; F.jumpChecked=true; F.stateT=3; F.tension=f.rod().maxTension*0.55; __rhf.hold('primary', false); return 'jump '+F.fish.species+' '+F.fish.weight.toFixed(1)+' dist '+F.dist.toFixed(1)})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.fishing.cancel(); const r=g.world.roads.find(r=>r.id==='river'); const P=r.path; const p=P.sample(P.length*0.3); const c=g.hotrod; c.place(p.x,p.z,Math.atan2(p.tx,p.tz)); const e=c.exitPoint(1); g.player.place(e.x,e.z,c.yaw); g.env.setTime(17.8); return 'car on river road at '+p.x.toFixed(0)+','+p.z.toFixed(0)})()
